India and China to Hold Corps Commander Talks Amid Border Friction

India and China are scheduled to hold Corps Commander-level talks in the northeastern sector of their disputed border. The meeting comes after a boundary discussion between Indian National Security Advisor Ajit Doval and Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi. Reports indicate the talks will address ongoing friction along the Line of Actual Control, particularly in the Arunachal Pradesh sector.
